Subject: Post-demo: cost validation + request for startup package & commitment options

Hi Alice — great to meet today and thanks for the demo time. Quick recap and a couple asks so we can prepare a formal pricing note:

1) Expected token volumes: you mentioned conversational traffic and an initial pilot of ~25M tokens/month ramping to ~40M/month over 3 quarters. Can you confirm whether those are total tokens or just generation tokens (we treat input+output together).

2) Budget envelope: you said the leadership budget goal is to keep unit costs around the $/1M-token range you felt comfortable with — can you share a target number (ballpark is fine). That helps me pick between starter credits vs committed tiers.

3) Procurement timing and decision owner: you referenced procurement joining after exec approval. Could you share the procurement contact and target PO date?

We can put together two panes: (A) a startup package (founder credits + usage cap) that reduces near-term $/1M tokens, and (B) committed-use (12/24 month) with stepped pricing and a multi-year incentive. If you confirm the volume and target $/1M, I’ll send a short comparison with examples and an SOW draft.

Attachments: I’ll include a lightweight pricing sheet and a draft SOW once I have your preference on commitment length.

Thanks — next step from my side is a clean pricing table by EOD Monday if you can confirm the two items above.

Warmly,
Sergio Alvarez

Sergio — thanks for the context. We can do the following vantage options for Acme (high level):

Option A — Startup package (3 months):
- One-time founder credit: $15,000 applied to usage for first 90 days.
- No long-term commit.
- Expected effective $/1M tokens at 36M/month pilot: ~ $560–$590 (depends on exact IO vs Gen split).

Option B — Committed-use 12 months (36M/month):
- Monthly committed tokens: 36M tokens/month (input+output).
- Unit price: $520 per 1M tokens baseline.
- Quarterly rebate: 5% if usage >= 95% of committed per quarter.
- Effective net $/1M with rebates & modest multi-year incentive: ~ $495.

Option C — Committed-use 24 months (36M/month):
- 24-month term, same monthly commit.
- Unit price: $500 per 1M tokens baseline.
- Multi-year incentive: one-time contract credit equal to 1 month of committed spend applied in year 2 (reduces effective $/1M).
- Effective net $/1M after incentive: ~ $470–$480.

Notes: these figures assume standard quantization profiles and typical conversational prefix caching. Monica, if there’s anything on cache hit rate that would materially change the token burn assumptions, flag it.

Attachments: pricing_sheet_Q3_2026.xlsx (detailed math) and redwood_draft_sow.pdf (SOW template).

Sergio — if you want to present these, I’m fine with a modest founder credit and the 24-month option sample. Approve any customer-facing discounts through me and I’ll sign off.

—Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
